% 808-read-loop-eof-count: verifies a three-line generated file reads back line by line until end-of-file.
\input prelude
\immediate\openout7=ls808data.txt
\immediate\write7{line one 808}
\immediate\write7{line two 808}
\immediate\write7{line three 808}
\immediate\closeout7
\openin7=ls808data.txt
\read7 to \gotA
\message{808 1=\meaning\gotA}
\read7 to \gotB
\message{808 2=\meaning\gotB}
\read7 to \gotC
\message{808 3=\meaning\gotC}
\read7 to \gotD
\ifeof7\message{808 eof-yes}\else\message{808 eof-no}\fi
\closein7
\setbox0=\hbox{\vrule width108pt height8pt depth2pt}
\lsshipbox0
\end
